payload.claim: `_open_prs` hardcodes `--limit 100` on `gh pr list`, so any open PRs beyond the first 100 are silently invisible to both the "another task" and "touches overlap" refusals. Every fixture and the module's own docstring frame this as a deliberately best-effort check, so this is a disclosed gap rather than a hidden one, but it is an assumption (few simultaneously open PRs) that holds in every test and may not hold on a busy target repo.
